TrainingWizard_Hp_hidden: Hidden units of the network: its size. Larger can fit more, and overfits more easily.

TrainingWizard_Hp_lr: Learning rate: the size of each update step. Too high is unstable, too low is slow.
TrainingWizard_Hp_weight_decay: L2 penalty on the weights; keeps them small to limit overfitting.
TrainingWizard_Hp_patience: Epochs without validation improvement before training stops early.
TrainingWizard_Hp_learning_rate: Shrinkage of each tree. Smaller needs more trees but generalises better.
TrainingWizard_Hp_num_leaves: Maximum leaves per tree: model complexity.
TrainingWizard_Hp_max_depth: Maximum tree depth. -1 means no limit.

TrainingWizard_Hp_early_stopping: Boosting rounds without validation improvement before training stops.

Settings_Backtest_Desc_InitialCapital: Starting account equity of a run, in the account currency. Must be greater than 0.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_CommissionFlat: Fixed commission charged per fill, in the account currency. 0 or greater.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_CommissionPerUnit: Commission per traded unit, in the account currency. 0 or greater.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_SlippageRatio: Adverse price move applied to each fill, as a ratio of price (0.001 = 0.1%). At least 0 and below 1.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_SizingModel: How the order quantity is decided: a fixed number of units or a share of equity.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_SizingParameter: Fixed Quantity: whole units, 1 or more. Percent of Equity: a ratio above 0 up to 1 (0.5 = 50%).
Settings_Backtest_Desc_InitialMarginRati: Margin required to open a position, as a ratio of its value (0.30 = 30%). Above 0, up to 1.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_MaintenanceMargin: Margin that must be kept while a position is open, as a ratio of its value. Must be smaller than the initial margin ratio.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_LiquidationPenalt: Extra cost of a forced liquidation, as a ratio of price (0.005 = 0.5%). At least 0 and below 1.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_AnnualRiskFreeRat: Simple annual risk-free rate as a ratio (0.02 = 2%). Must be greater than -1.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_AnnualMar: Simple annual minimum acceptable return as a ratio. Must be greater than -1.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_AnnualPeriods: Number of bars per year used to annualize the metrics of each timeframe, from 1 to 366.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_BootstrapSeed: Random seed of the bootstrap behind the autocorrelation-adjusted Sortino ratio. The same seed gives the same result.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_BootstrapIteratio: Number of bootstrap resamples for that Sortino ratio. 1000 or more.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_EquityColorMode: What the equity curve in the Results tab switches its color on.
Settings_Backtest_Hint_EquityMode_Single: The whole curve is drawn in the line color.
Settings_Backtest_Hint_EquityMode_Previo: Each segment is drawn in the up color when its end equity is greater than or equal to its start equity, otherwise in the down color. The color can switch often.
Settings_Backtest_Hint_EquityMode_Drawdo: The high is the highest equity so far, including the initial capital. A segment is drawn in the new high color when it ends at a new high or level with the high; a segment that ends below the high is drawn in the drawdown color.
Settings_Backtest_Desc_EquityLineColor: Color of the Single mode, and of the dot when a result has only one point.
Settings_Backtest_GroupE_Note: Saving also repaints the Results tab of Backtest windows that are already open.
Settings_TrainingWizard_Intro: Optional limits for new composed-feature training jobs. An off item has no override: the child inherits its environment, and Python uses its own fallback for missing or invalid values. Resolved limits appear in training diagnostics after launch. Running jobs and AI prediction are unaffected.
Settings_TrainingWizard_ReadOnly: Another Settings window is editing these limits. Reopen this page after it closes to edit.
Settings_TrainingWizard_InvalidNumber: Enabled limits require a whole number within the displayed range. The previous preview remains active.
Settings_TrainingWizard_ChannelsHelp: Caps the number of composed input channels (C).
Settings_TrainingWizard_TensorHelp: Caps one float32 window: 4 x W x C bytes, where W is bars per window and C is channels. Measured in MiB; this is not total process memory (RSS).
Settings_TrainingWizard_SamplesHelp: Caps each symbol's candidate windows and the cumulative retained train plus validation samples. Exceeding the cap fails training; samples are not automatically downsampled.
Settings_Tickers_AutoPlayDesc: Behavior of the Auto Play checkbox on the Tickers tab, which selects the next ticker of the displayed list at a fixed interval.
Settings_Tickers_Desc_StopAtListEnd: When the interval elapses while the last row of the list is displayed, Auto Play stops instead of returning to the first row.
Settings_Tickers_Desc_StopOnListChange: Auto Play stops when you select a different ticker list.
Settings_Tickers_Desc_IntervalSeconds: Seconds between automatic ticker changes. Only whole seconds within the allowed range can be entered.
Settings_Tickers_ColumnsDesc: How the Column Customization dropdown at the top of the Tickers tab remembers its selection.
Settings_Tickers_Desc_ColumnSelectionSco: Per list: each ticker list remembers its own Column Customization selection (default). Shared: all ticker lists use one common selection.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ReadMoreMaxCharacter: When a Note's body exceeds this character count, it is collapsed behind a "Read more" toggle.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ReadMoreMaxLines: When a Note's body contains more newlines than this, it is collapsed behind a "Read more" toggle.
Settings_Notes_ThreadCollapseDesc: When a reply chain (thread) exceeds a certain length, the middle posts are omitted and shown as a dotted line. Omitted posts cannot be re-expanded in the timeline, but remain viewable from their own individual detail page.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ThreadCollapseThresh: When a thread's post count exceeds this number, the middle posts are collapsed.
Settings_Notes_Desc_TailVisibleCount: How many posts stay visible at the start and at the end when collapsed.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ConnectorLineLength: Height of the dotted vertical line shown for a collapsed section.
Settings_Notes_Desc_DashLength: Length of each dash making up the collapsed section's vertical line.
Settings_Notes_TimelineLoadingDesc: Controls how many posts the main timeline loads at once, both on first display and each time you scroll near the bottom (infinite scroll). Posts hidden by thread collapse do not count toward this number.
Settings_Notes_Desc_TimelinePageSize: Number of visible timeline posts loaded initially, and loaded again each time you scroll close to the bottom.
Settings_Notes_AppearanceDesc: Set the font size, text color, background color, and URL/hashtag colors for every piece of text the Notes tab displays (body, header, timestamps, quoted-note preview, attachment counts, and the Trash view). These settings are independent of Settings > Theme and Settings > Fonts - changing those has no effect on Notes.
Settings_Notes_Desc_BodyFontSize: Font size for all text Notes displays.
Settings_Notes_Desc_BodyTextColor: Text color for all text Notes displays.
Settings_Notes_Desc_UrlColor: Text color for clickable URLs inside a Note's body.
Settings_Notes_Desc_HashtagColor: Text color for clickable hashtags inside a Note's body.
Settings_Notes_ImagesDesc: Configure the thumbnail size and where attached images render within a posted Note.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ThumbnailSize: Side length (px) of an attachment thumbnail shown on a Note card and while composing a New Note.
Settings_Notes_Desc_ImageDisplayMode: Whether attached images render together at the bottom of the article (Attachment List) or at the position within the text where they were attached (Inline).
Settings_Notes_Desc_MaxRenderedThumbnail: Number of attachment thumbnails rendered on a Note card before the rest collapse into a "+N" count.
Settings_Notes_UpcomingCatalystsDesc: Configure the number of upcoming catalysts displayed in the right column and how many days to continue displaying after the scheduled date has passed.
Settings_Notes_Desc_UpcomingCatalystsLim: Maximum number of upcoming catalysts to display.
Settings_Notes_Desc_UpcomingCatalystsRet: Number of days to continue displaying after the scheduled date has passed.
Settings_Chart_Drawing_ShiftClickHint: Shift + Left Click: Deletes the drawing tool under the cursor (or finalizes the shape currently being drawn).
Settings_Chart_Drawing_CtrlClickHint: Ctrl + Left Click: For tools with no fixed number of points, finalizes the shape with the last placed control point as its endpoint. Always returns to the Pointer tool afterward, even when Continue Drawing is enabled.
Settings_Chart_Drawing_AltKeyHint: Alt (while drawing): Prevents the drawing tool from snapping to other drawing tools or to chart data (e.g. candles).
Settings_Chart_StrokeThickness_Desc: Sets the default line thickness for newly created drawing tools.
Settings_Chart_DrawingDefaultColor_Desc: Default color for newly created drawing tools (lines, shapes, annotations).
Settings_Chart_DrawingHandleColor_Desc: Color for anchor point circles on selected drawing objects.
Settings_Chart_DrawingAnchorPointColor_D: Highlight color for a drawing object's reference/anchor control point (the pivot used for rotation and extension-line operations). By default the start point (first clicked point) is the anchor.
Settings_Chart_DrawingFontSize_Desc: Font size for auto-generated text labels in drawing tools (Fibonacci, Elliott Wave, Angle, etc.).
Settings_Chart_DrawingIconFontSize_Desc: Sets the default font size for newly placed icon drawing tools (Default: 32).
Settings_Chart_SmartGuidesEnabled_Desc: Automatically snap objects to edges and centers of other objects during move and resize operations.
Settings_Chart_SmartGuideSnapThreshold_D: Pixel distance threshold to trigger smart guide snapping and alignment line rendering (default: 5.0px).
Settings_Chart_ControlPointHideTimeout_D: Seconds of no pointer activity before a selected drawing tool's control points auto-hide (default: 5s).
Settings_Chart_DrawingToolContinuationMo: For tools with a fixed start/end point (e.g. Trend Line, Rectangle), what happens once the last point is placed.
Settings_Chart_DrawingLinkMode_Desc: When linking drawing tools in the Layers Panel, choose whether child tools move to the parent's anchor point (AP) or keep their current relative position. A change applies only to later link operations; existing link groups are not changed.
Settings_Chart_RoundingMode_Desc: Select the mathematical method for aligning prices to a grid. Affects Renko, Kagi, and P&F charts.
Settings_Chart_Renko_Desc: Renko charts filter out noise by focusing solely on price movement using fixed brick sizes.
Settings_Chart_Candlestick_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of standard candlestick charts.
Settings_Chart_OHLCBar_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of OHLC (Open-High-Low-Close) bar charts.
Settings_Chart_Kagi_Desc: Kagi charts highlight trend reversals based on price movement regardless of time.
Settings_Chart_Pnf_Desc: Point & Figure charts ignore time and volume, focusing only on significant price changes and trend reversals.
Settings_Chart_Line_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of line charts.
Settings_Chart_Area_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of area charts.
Settings_Chart_Dot_Desc: A chart type that plots a dot marker at the specified price for each bar.
Settings_Chart_HeikinAshi_Desc: Configure the visual appearance of Heikin Ashi charts.
Settings_Chart_ThreeLineBreak_Desc: Three Line Break charts focus on price reversals by requiring a break of the previous three lines' highs or lows.
Settings_Chart_RelativePerformance_Desc: Compare the performance of multiple tickers on a relative basis. Percentage Change, Ratio, or Z-Score (Standardized) can be displayed.
Settings_Chart_ReverseWatch_Desc: Plots the correlation between price and volume on a 2D plane to visualize market cycles (Phase 1-8).
Settings_Chart_Item_EnableExtendedLookba: Fetches extra historical bars beyond the displayed range so long-period indicators (e.g. SMA200) don't show a gap near the start. Off by default.
PythonSetup_Message:
Python execution environment is not configured.

A Python environment is required to use advanced indicators and data synchronization features.
Would you like to automatically download and set up the embedded Python environment?
(This will take 1–2 minutes and requires an internet connection.)

*Select 'Configure Manually' if you wish to set up Python yourself.
PythonSetup_Manual_Instructions:
[Manual Setup Instructions]

1. Prepare a Python 3.8-3.11 environment. (Using a virtual environment is recommended to avoid conflicts.)
2. Open a command prompt, navigate to the root directory of this project, and install the dependencies:
   pip install -r StockAnalyzer.Python/requirements.txt
3. Open the [StockAnalyzer.Avalonia/appsettings.json] file, and append the absolute path to your python.exe in the [PythonPath] key under the [Python] section.

   Example:
   "Python": {
     "PythonPath": "C:\\path\\to\\python.exe"
   }

*Please restart the application after completing the setup.

Python environment is configured. Would you like to check for and install updates for the required Python libraries?

PythonUpdate_Manual_Instructions:

1. Open a command prompt, navigate to the root directory of this project, and run the following command to update libraries:
   pip install -r StockAnalyzer.Python/requirements.txt --upgrade
2. Restart the application to apply the changes.

Explainability_RepresentativeNote: Representative cases from the validation period (highest class probability and most recent). They do not explain the current prediction.
Explainability_ShapNote: Shapley values in probability space: base + sum of contributions = predicted probability. Each bar is one channel (all window bars and lags together), not a price unit. Channels are replaced independently against training backgrounds, so input correlations and market feasibility are not preserved. The value after ± is the standard error of the permutation average. Only the five largest are shown.
Explainability_PdpNote: Mean probability when one channel is shifted by a constant offset in the model input space (quantiles of the training distribution). This is the response to an artificial input shift, not the dependence observed in real market data. OHLC consistency is not preserved and shifted values can leave the training range (the share is shown per row); read it as sensitivity, not as a forecast.
Explainability_PdpOutOfSupport: · up to {0:0.0%} of shifted values outside the training range
Explainability_StabilityNote: Sampling reliability ({2} permutations): largest standard error {0:0.0000}, largest change when only the first half of the permutations is used {1:0.0000}. Informational; no threshold is applied.
Calibration_None: This model's probabilities are not calibrated.
Calibration_RequestedUnavailable: Calibration was requested but not applied: {0}.
Calibration_LoadFailed: The calibration of this model could not be read, so its probabilities cannot be shown.
Calibration_Detail: Calibration segment: {0} samples. Outer test ({1} samples): NLL {2:0.000} → {3:0.000}, Brier {4:0.000} → {5:0.000}, ECE {6:0.000} → {7:0.000}.
Calibration_DisabledBoundary: A calibration was fitted but is not applied: the temperature (T = {0:0.###}) lies on the search boundary, so the data gave no informative optimum. Probabilities are the raw model output.
Calibration_OutsideStandard: The fitted temperature lies outside the standard range {0}–{1}; review the model before relying on it.
TrainingWizard_StackingWeightSource_Note: Default: out-of-fold predictions of earlier folds, whose models saw less data than the registered members (the weights may not transfer exactly). Meta segment: the latest part of the final fold's training data is held out, the registered members are trained without it, and the weights are fitted on their own predictions there; the members therefore lose that part of their training data. The final test fold is never used to fit.
TrainingWizard_Ensemble_Note: Every member is trained and evaluated independently and registered as its own model generation; the ensemble mixes their probabilities linearly. Bagging resamples each member's training windows in time-ordered blocks; stacking fits the mixture weights on out-of-fold predictions only, never on the final test fold. Training time grows with the number of members. Classification only; cannot be combined with calibration, pretraining, FineTune or Resume.
TrainingWizard_Pretraining_Note: 30% of the bars of each training window are hidden and reconstructed before the supervised stage starts from those weights. Only the training windows are used; the output head is trained from scratch, so the model format is unchanged.

TrainingWizard_Status_EnsembleWeightTran: Note: the stacking weights were fitted on out-of-fold rows of earlier folds (shorter training windows), while the registered members are the latest fold's models, so the weights may not transfer exactly.
TrainingWizard_Status_EnsembleApplied: The active ensemble now has {0} members.
TrainingWizard_Status_EnsembleError: The ensemble could not be applied: {0}
TrainingWizard_Cpcv_Note: The common calendar is cut into consecutive groups and every combination of test groups is scored by a fresh model trained on the remaining windows, with overlapping windows purged and an embargo of one horizon after each test span. Only each combination's own scores are reported: no backtest path is built, the count is not a number of paths, and the released model is not one of these fits. CPCV scores are a robustness diagnostic, not an estimate of deployed performance: the combinations share training windows and train on both sides of each test group (unlike the walk-forward folds, which train on the past only), so their mean and spread are not independent samples and must not be read next to the out-of-sample results.
